rooms.name: Inside the Pub
rooms.desc:
This run-down wooden building has seen better days. Business seems really
slow.

rooms.name: A Dirt Road through the Forest
rooms.desc:
The ironwood trees begin to thin out, giving way to huge ancient willows 
and oaks festooned with spanish moss.  The effect is eerie.  A trail running
roughly north and south can be barely made out, and a narrow path to the east
leads behind some tall ironwood trees.
   As you scan the trail to the south, you make out a set of gates, mostly
obscured by the branches that jut out into the path.

rooms.name: A Dirt Road through the Forest
rooms.desc:
The forest crowds in around you, as if eager to reclaim the path you are
travelling upon.  In some places the brush is so thick that you are forced to
hack your way through.  In one such section, your efforts reveal a decrepit
building just to your east.  You can still see remnants of the path to your 
north and south.

rooms.name: Before a Pagan Altar
rooms.desc:
This shrine has seen better days.  The roof has collapsed, leaves are piled
in several places, the door is ripped from its hinges, creaking eerily with the
wind. Something about the altar nags at you though.  The forest is to your west.

small bridge. Directly west of here is rough stone wall bordering what
appears to be a town and a rather large castle.

rooms.name: On the T(r)oll Bridge
rooms.desc:
Heavy snoring sounds from below as you pass over this rough wooden
bridge.

rooms.name: Town Center
rooms.desc:
An abandoned castle can be seen across a moat to the north. A gate closes
off a narrow road that leads behind some buildings to the east and a rickety
bridge is to the west.

rooms.name: The Narrow Road

rooms.name: The Narrow Road

rooms.name: The Narrow Road

   To the southeast lies the walls of a small town, the center of which
houses a rather stately castle. South of here you can see a gate in the
wall, and in all other directions lies forest.
